population.completenessStatement: Posts-route records plus account-authored reply-only records reconcile exactly to the 183-item authenticated profile count. This is complete recovery of the surviving July 2026 profile population, not a native X export, deletion history, or proof that no older item was deleted before capture.

method.exclusions: Five conversation-context articles owned by other accounts were excluded from the account-attributable population.
method.authenticationBoundary: Authentication was used only to read public material. No credential, cookie, direct message, private analytics, or administrator record is represented here.
method.contentBoundary: The ledger stores classifications, public metadata, summaries, and content digests rather than raw post text.

aggregateFindings.metricBoundary: All reaction figures are mutable July 2026 interface observations, not historical analytics, unique people, complete engagement histories, endorsement, adoption, reach, or impact. Metrics on reposted statuses belong to their source statuses.
